distribution: 云南屏边大围山（海拔七百米）。
en: The soldier head is pale yellowish brown and densely pubescent, squarish with rounded, slightly swollen sides. The labrum is trapezoidal with an almost straight tip. Mandibles are hook-like, the left slightly more than half the head length and less than two-thirds the greatest head width, each with a large blunt tooth near the apical third and a minute basal tooth. Antennae have 14 segments. The postmentum is club-shaped and the saddle-shaped pronotum is depressed at the hind margin.
soldier: 头淡黄褐而密被短柔毛，上颚褐而带红，触角白黄，胸腹白黄。头方而带圆，两侧稍鼓出，前缘浅凹，后缘宽圆；上唇梯形而端稍直；上颚钩状，左上颚长稍过头壳之半而不及头最宽的三分之二，两颚各有一大钝齿位于颚端三分之一处或偏前，颚基上方各具一微尖齿；触角十四节，第三节稍长于第二节；后颏棍棒状，腰狭零点三三毫米；前胸背板马鞍状，后缘中央稍凹并低陷。
